sources.citation: Zorc, R. David. 1979. On the development of contrastive word accent: Pangasinan, a case in point. Pacific Linguistics C-45: 241-258.
sources.note: Names Buhid (South Mangyan) among languages that 'do not reflect PPH accent'; North Mangyan/Tadyawan not mentioned.

sources.citation: Zorc, R. David. 1978. Proto-Philippine word accent: innovation or Proto-Hesperonesian retention? In Wurm & Carrington (eds.), SICAL Proceedings fasc. 1, 67-119. Pacific Linguistics C-61.
sources.note: Tadyawan appears only in the tree diagram (p.8 of offprint, North Mangyan) and once as a witness with penult accent, 'Tadyawan dáyaq' for PPH *dáRa[q] 'earth' (set 37, p.10) -- implicitly treated as accent-retaining, but no statement about Tadyawan accent.

sources.citation: Zorc, R. David. 1974. Internal and external relationships of the Mangyan languages. Oceanic Linguistics 13: 561-600.
sources.note: Silent on Tadyawan stress. Only accent mentions: bracketed remark that Bisayan -an suffixes are distinguished by accent; fn. 9 defines aphesis ('loss of a short unaccented initial syllable') for Iraya nag-; fn. 4 Tadyawan kama < *kami 'change of the final vowel'. Tadyawan forms cited with accent marks in tables only.

sources.citation: Zorc, R. David. [1972]. Tadyawan (Pola) field data. Handwritten notes (tape-sample transcription, verb paradigms, pronouns), Proto-Philippine worksheet 'Pola => Tadyawan', Proto-Austronesian worksheet (informant Dominggo Ramos, c.50, Bo. Tagbakin, Pola), plus appended typescript: Pack, D. (OMF), n.d., 'Tadyawan Vocabulary Section II' (pp. 42-75). 75 pp., posted at zorc.net.
sources.note: No prose statement. Accent is marked lexically with an acute on every transcribed form, and both ultima and penult accents occur (p.3: walúʔ 'eight', limá, tulú, upát, sulát, kabán, akú vs. tadyáwan, sákup, púlaʔ, báyan; p.4: pálay, súliʔ, gábiʔ vs. tanám, kamáy, bukán), i.e. the fieldworker treats accent as unpredictable/contrastive, but never says so in words. Pack's vocabulary likewise marks accent per word without comment.
